results.text: Comparative Effectiveness and Safety of Amlodipine, Telmisartan, and Chlorthalidone in Newly Diagnosed Hypertensive Indian Adults. Amlodipine, telmisartan, and chlorthalidone are the most prescribed antihypertensive drugs in the Indian population. In this study, we compared the effectiveness and safety of these drugs in newly diagnosed hypertensive adults. Haloperidol Versus Atypical Antipsychotics for Delirium in Hospitalized and ICU Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
